## Network Trends

History assembled from a snapshot of the routing tables taken every fifteen
minutes. These are trends over time, not the live picture; for current state
see the [status page](status.qmd).

<div id="trends-summary" class="status-card metric-grid">
  <div class="metric"><strong>Tracking since:</strong> <span id="t-since">...</span></div>
  <div class="metric"><strong>Snapshots:</strong> <span id="t-snaps">...</span></div>
  <div class="metric"><strong>Distinct nodes seen:</strong> <span id="t-nodes">...</span></div>
  <div class="metric"><strong>Active peers now:</strong> <span id="t-peers">...</span></div>
</div>

<div style="margin:14px 0; font-family:sans-serif;">

## Peer Scorecard

How reliably each peer has been reachable, and how many nodes it can itself
reach (its horizon, from its own routing table).

<p class="text-muted">Uptime is measured from GB7CAM's vantage point, so a gap
can reflect this node or its link being down rather than a fault at the peer.</p>

<div id="peers-container" class="panel">
  <p>Loading...</p>
</div>

---

## Node Stability

What fraction of snapshots each node has appeared in. The stable core is present
in every snapshot; the marginal ones flicker in and out, and are the routes a
stricter quality threshold would drop first.

<div id="stability-container" class="panel">
  <p>Loading...</p>
</div>

---

## Peer Overlap

How much the peers duplicate each other. Unique contribution is how many nodes
are reachable through exactly one peer, and it moves a lot: see the notebook
post [Packet Networks and Protein Networks](https://g0lft.org/notebook-posts/2026-07-24-packet-networks-and-protein-networks/2026-07-24-packet-networks-and-protein-networks.html)
on g0lft.org for why.

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4"></script>

<script>
const BASE = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk";
const NODE_COLOUR = "#1f77b4";   // AXIP blue
const PEER_COLOUR = "#2ca02c";   // RF green
const PEER_PALETTE = {           // per-peer colours for the overlap chart
  "GB7BDH": "#4dabf7", "GB7BED-5": "#ff6b6b", "GB7NPR": "#f6a821", "G0NMY-7": "#20c997",
};
const FALLBACK = ["#845ef7", "#e64980", "#12b886", "#fab005", "#495057"];
const MONTHS = ["Jan","Feb","Mar","Apr","May","Jun","Jul","Aug","Sep","Oct","Nov","Dec"];

function pUTC(iso) { return new Date(iso.endsWith("Z") ? iso : iso + "Z"); }
function fmtFull(iso) {
  const d = pUTC(iso);
  return `${d.getUTCDate()} ${MONTHS[d.getUTCMonth()]} ${d.getUTCFullYear()}, `
       + `${String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2,"0")} UTC`;
}
function fmtLabel(iso, hours) {
  const d = pUTC(iso);
  const dm = `${d.getUTCDate()} ${MONTHS[d.getUTCMonth()]}`;
  if (hours > 72) return dm;   // long ranges: date only
  return `${dm} ${String(d.getUTCHours()).padStart(2,"0")}:${String(d.getUTCMinutes()).padStart(2,"0")}`;
}

let timelineChart = null;
let overlapChart = null;

async function loadRanged(hours) {
  const [tlR, ovR] = await Promise.all([
    fetch(`${BASE}/history/timeline?hours=${hours}`),
    fetch(`${BASE}/history/overlap-timeline?hours=${hours}`),
  ]);
  const tl = (await tlR.json());
  const timeline = tl.timeline || [];
  const series = (await ovR.json()).series || [];

  document.getElementById("range-note").innerText =
    timeline.length ? `${timeline.length} points, ${tl.bucket_minutes} min each` : "";
  if (timeline.length) document.getElementById("t-peers").innerText = timeline[timeline.length - 1].peers;

  /* timeline chart */
  if (timelineChart) timelineChart.destroy();
  timelineChart = new Chart(document.getElementById("timelineChart"), {
    type: "line",
    data: {
      labels: timeline.map(p => fmtLabel(p.ts, hours)),
      datasets: [
        { label: "Nodes visible", data: timeline.map(p => p.nodes), borderColor: NODE_COLOUR,
          yAxisID: "yNodes", tension: 0.25, pointRadius: 0, borderWidth: 2 },
        { label: "Active peers", data: timeline.map(p => p.peers), borderColor: PEER_COLOUR,
          yAxisID: "yPeers", tension: 0.15, pointRadius: 0, borderWidth: 2, stepped: true },
      ],
    },
    options: {
      responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, interaction: { mode: "index", intersect: false },
      scales: {
        x: { ticks: { maxTicksLimit: 9, autoSkip: true } },
        yNodes: { position: "left", beginAtZero: true, title: { display: true, text: "nodes" } },
        yPeers: { position: "right", beginAtZero: true, suggestedMax: 6, grid: { drawOnChartArea: false },
                  title: { display: true, text: "peers" }, ticks: { stepSize: 1 } },
      },
    },
  });

  /* overlap-over-time chart: one line per peer */
  const peers = [...new Set(series.map(r => r.peer))];
  const buckets = [...new Set(series.map(r => r.ts))].sort();
  const byPeerTs = {};
  series.forEach(r => { (byPeerTs[r.peer] ||= {})[r.ts] = r.unique_nodes; });
  if (overlapChart) overlapChart.destroy();
  overlapChart = new Chart(document.getElementById("overlapChart"), {
    type: "line",
    data: {
      labels: buckets.map(ts => fmtLabel(ts, hours)),
      datasets: peers.map((p, i) => ({
        label: p, data: buckets.map(ts => byPeerTs[p][ts] ?? null),
        borderColor: PEER_PALETTE[p] || FALLBACK[i % FALLBACK.length],
        tension: 0.25, pointRadius: 0, borderWidth: 2, spanGaps: true,
      })),
    },
    options: {
      responsive: true, maintainAspectRatio: false, interaction: { mode: "index", intersect: false },
      scales: {
        x: { ticks: { maxTicksLimit: 9, autoSkip: true } },
        y: { beginAtZero: true, title: { display: true, text: "nodes unique to this peer" } },
      },
    },
  });
}

async function loadStatic() {
  const [peersR, stabilityR, overlapR] = await Promise.all([
    fetch(BASE + "/history/peers"),
    fetch(BASE + "/history/stability"),
    fetch(BASE + "/history/overlap"),
  ]);
  const peers = (await peersR.json()).peers || [];
  const stability = await stabilityR.json();
  const overlap = await overlapR.json();

  document.getElementById("t-snaps").innerText = stability.total_snapshots ?? "—";
  const nodes = stability.nodes || [];
  document.getElementById("t-nodes").innerText = nodes.length;
  if (stability.first_ts) document.getElementById("t-since").innerText = fmtFull(stability.first_ts);

  /* peer scorecard */
  document.getElementById("peers-container").innerHTML = `
    <table class="table-dashboard">
      <thead><tr><th>Peer</th><th>Uptime</th><th>Seen</th><th>Reach (nodes it can see)</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>${peers.map(p => `
        <tr><td style="font-weight:bold;">${p.peer}</td><td>${p.uptime_pct}%</td>
        <td>${p.snapshots_seen} / ${p.snapshots_total}</td><td>${p.reach ?? "—"}</td></tr>`).join("")}
      </tbody>
    </table>`;

  /* Node stability: top-N most stable and bottom-N least stable, rather than a
     fixed percentage. 100% erodes over time - any flap, or GB7CAM's own
     downtime, drops nodes off it - so top/bottom N stays meaningful whatever
     the absolute levels. The summary counts use soft thresholds for context. */
  const N = Math.min(15, Math.floor(nodes.length / 2));
  const mostStable = nodes.slice(0, N);                    // endpoint sorts pct desc
  const leastStable = nodes.slice(-N).reverse();           // bottom N, least first
  const reliable = nodes.filter(n => n.pct >= 90).length;
  const marginal = nodes.filter(n => n.pct < 50).length;
  document.getElementById("stability-container").innerHTML = `
    <div class="metric-grid" style="margin-bottom:10px;">
      <div class="metric"><strong>Total tracked:</strong> ${nodes.length}</div>
      <div class="metric"><strong>Reliable (&ge; 90%):</strong> ${reliable}</div>
      <div class="metric"><strong>Marginal (&lt; 50%):</strong> ${marginal}</div>
    </div>
    <div style="display:flex; gap:16px; flex-wrap:wrap;">
      <div style="flex:1; min-width:260px;">
        <p class="text-muted">The ${N} most stable, most consistent first:</p>
        <table class="table-dashboard"><thead><tr><th>Node</th><th>Present in</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>${mostStable.map(n => `<tr><td>${n.node}</td><td>${n.pct}%</td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table>
      </div>
      <div style="flex:1; min-width:260px;">
        <p class="text-muted">The ${N} least stable, least consistent first:</p>
        <table class="table-dashboard"><thead><tr><th>Node</th><th>Present in</th></tr></thead>
          <tbody>${leastStable.map(n => `<tr><td>${n.node}</td><td>${n.pct}%</td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody></table>
      </div>
    </div>`;

  /* overlap latest */
  const contrib = overlap.contribution || [];
  const pairs = overlap.pairwise || [];
  document.getElementById("overlap-container").innerHTML = `
    <p class="text-muted">Unique contribution per peer:</p>
    <table class="table-dashboard">
      <thead><tr><th>Peer</th><th>Nodes via</th><th>Unique to it</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>${contrib.map(c => `<tr><td style="font-weight:bold;">${c.peer}</td><td>${c.nodes_via}</td><td>${c.unique_nodes}</td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody>
    </table>
    <p class="text-muted" style="margin-top:14px;">Pairwise overlap (Jaccard):</p>
    <table class="table-dashboard">
      <thead><tr><th>Peer A</th><th>Peer B</th><th>Shared</th><th>Jaccard</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>${pairs.map(p => `<tr><td>${p.peer_a}</td><td>${p.peer_b}</td><td>${p.shared}</td><td>${p.jaccard}</td></tr>`).join("")}</tbody>
    </table>`;
}

async function init() {
  try {
    await loadStatic();   // sets "tracking since" from stability.first_ts
    await loadRanged(parseInt(document.getElementById("range-select").value, 10));
    document.getElementById("range-select").addEventListener("change", e => {
      loadRanged(parseInt(e.target.value, 10)).catch(console.error);
    });
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Trends load failed:", e);
    for (const id of ["peers-container", "stability-container", "overlap-container"]) {
      document.getElementById(id).innerHTML = "<p class='text-muted'>Trend data unavailable right now.</p>";
    }
  }
}

init();
</script>
